title: puccinellia geniculata
intro: Puccinellia geniculata, commonly known as bent grass, is a type of grass native to Asia and Europe. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Puccinellia geniculata include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory conditions, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
